image_description: Two golf carts parked side-by-side in front of a building with an orange facade. The cart on the right is beige with a blue weather enclosure (curtains) and a white roof. The cart on the left is white with a striped blue-and-white canopy and a rear rack holding black baskets. A dark sedan is partially visible in the garage background behind the left cart.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small motorized vehicle, compact enough to navigate narrow golf course paths.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both vehicles exhibit the characteristic compact, boxy silhouette of standard golf carts, significantly smaller than the car in the background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is open-sided with roof canopy (fabric or hardtop).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The left cart has a fabric canopy; the right cart has a hardtop roof with added fabric side enclosures. Both fit the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Seating for multiple passengers in bench configuration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Bench-style seating is visible through the windshield of the right cart and implied by the width of the left cart.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Steering wheel and simple dashboard (speed control, battery indicator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A steering wheel is clearly visible inside the right cart. Dashboard details are obscured by reflections/enclosure but the general layout is consistent.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear cargo area for golf bags.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The left cart clearly displays a rear rack structure designed for carrying items (currently holding baskets), which is the standard location for golf bag storage.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wheels are small with turf-friendly tires.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Wheels are proportionally small relative to the body. Tread pattern is not high-resolution enough to confirm 'turf-friendly' specifics, but they lack aggressive off-road lugs, appearing consistent with street/turf tires.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Frame is steel or aluminum tubular construction.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The structural frame is largely covered by body panels and plastic trim. While the roll bars are visible, the primary chassis material cannot be visually verified as steel or aluminum without X-ray or close-up inspection of welds/joints.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Electric variant: battery pack under seat. Gas variant: small engine at rear with exhaust.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The powertrain components are completely occluded by the bodywork and seats. It is impossible to determine if these are electric or gas models from this exterior view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Color is white, green, blue, or custom.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The left cart is white; the right is beige (custom/light neutral) with blue accents. These fall within acceptable color variations.

artifact_observations.location: Front panel of the right golf cart
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text logo on the front nose of the beige cart appears slightly soft and indistinct. While it resembles letters ('Club Car'?), the character edges bleed slightly into the background, typical of AI generation struggling with small, specific branding text.

artifact_observations.location: Blue side curtain of the right golf cart
artifact_observations.reasoning: The fabric texture of the blue enclosure is overly smooth and uniform, lacking the fine wrinkles, stitching details, or tension folds expected from a vinyl/plastic weather cover stretched over a frame.

artifact_observations.location: Rear wheel of the left golf cart
artifact_observations.reasoning: The rear left wheel appears slightly elliptical in a way that doesn't perfectly match the perspective of the front wheel, suggesting a minor geometric inconsistency in the wheel alignment or rendering.
